review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C scenario. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, repository identity/base commit, and the exact four-file binding scope agree with the original PRD. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as hypothetical input without claiming a human Decision; only that selected branch is required. Consequently, ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate for C, while a material unresolved DEC-001 in paired B must still block at decisions. The runtime source supports the specified scheduling point, reuse of the sampled and rounded backoff, budget cap, zero-delay behavior, and required post-hook cancellation check. Package exports establish index.js and index.d.ts as maintained implementation/declaration owners, with test.js and index.test-d.ts as regression owners; package.json supplies the inspection-only validation entry point. Task roles, independent verification dependency, and required AC coverage are consistent. The designated implementer and verifier have available capacity and supplied active project-scoped claims for the relevant capabilities, including data.change and integration.consumer; pending security.authorization claims are not used to establish eligibility. An independent active project reviewer is configured. Historical project reuse is explicitly scoped, and old operations are not presented as fresh candidate evidence. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree; provenance explains the distinct source digest domains and PRD whitespace normalization. The original preparation placeholders are superseded by the supplied frozen preview facts. This approval relies on the supplied Service-bound fingerprints and recorded facts, not independently recomputed digests, executed tests, candidate outputs, or a new human attestation.
